decision: Build one knowledge-workflow seed per track before implementing media or maps.

seeds.evidence_decision: The reviewed interval identifies the wooden block-stacking game, and Ego2Web record 309 directly requests the matching knowledge article and two report fields.

proposed_intervention.a: Find and save the reference article for the tabletop game I am playing.
proposed_intervention.b: Also submit the standard-set piece count and the section that states it.
proposed_intervention.bundled: Find and save the reference article for the tabletop game I am playing, then submit the standard-set piece count and the section that states it.

seeds.belief_before: The matching article is sufficient before the later request.
seeds.belief_after: The same article must remain selected and two exact article-backed fields must be submitted.
seeds.required_behavior_change: Preserve the selected article and complete the newly required structured fields.
seeds.no_update_failure: The article is saved but the new fields are absent or wrong.
seeds.overupdate_failure: The Agent abandons the visually grounded game and answers from an unrelated stacking-game article.

seeds.evidence_decision: The reviewed sequence shows a blue ingredient packet opened first and a different yellow packet later; record 327 asks for the article describing the first ingredient as a baking leavening agent.
seeds.proposed_instruction: Find and save the reference article for the ingredient packet I open first, then submit how the article describes its role in baking.
seeds.belief_before: The blue packet opened first determines the target article.
seeds.belief_after: The later yellow packet is a distractor; the target article remains the one for the first blue packet.
seeds.required_behavior_change: Process the later view without replacing the first-ingredient article.
seeds.no_update_failure: The Agent loses the target or fails to finish after the later view.
seeds.overupdate_failure: The Agent switches to an article for the later yellow packet.

seeds.evidence_decision: The reviewed interval contains a solar-system poster first and an Uncle Sam poster second; record 34 requests creator and production-year facts for the second poster.
seeds.proposed_ambiguous_instruction: Find and save the reference record for the poster I examined, then submit its creator and production year.
seeds.proposed_oracle_instruction: Find and save the reference record for the second poster I examined, then submit its creator and production year.
seeds.belief_before: Either poster record could satisfy the unqualified request.
seeds.belief_after: The answer uniquely selects the second, Uncle Sam poster record.
seeds.required_behavior_change: Ask before opening or saving a candidate record, then use the answer to select the correct record and fields.
seeds.no_update_failure: The Agent guesses a poster record before asking or selects the first poster after the answer.
seeds.overupdate_failure: The Agent asks in the oracle arm despite already receiving the ordinal.
